content: The American Diabetes Association (ADA) recommends specific glucose targets for individuals managing diabetes. The target fasting blood glucose level should be maintained between 63-140 mg/dL (3.5-7.8 mmol/L). The goal for Time in Range (TIR) is to achieve at least 70% of glucose readings within this range. For Time Below Range (TBR), blood glucose levels below 63 mg/dL (3.5 mmol/L) should be limited to less than 4% of the time. For Time Above Range (TAR), blood glucose levels exceeding 140 mg/dL (7.8 mmol/L) should be restricted to less than 25% of the time.
